# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Kanban Todo Board

**Purpose**: Validate that the user-experience requirements in spec.md are complete, unambiguous, consistent, and measurable before `/speckit-plan` converts them into design decisions
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the fields visible on a card's face specified (title only, or title plus a note preview)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the placement of the add-card entry point defined (inline per column, overlay, or separate screen)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how the delete confirmation identifies which card is about to be removed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for where non-field errors appear (e.g. "card no longer exists"), as distinct from field-level messages? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for feedback shown while an action is still in progress? [Gap, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the content or intent of each column's empty-state message specified, including whether it differs per column? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for keyboard focus placement after a card is added, moved, edited, or deleted? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for how a card's column change is announced to assistive technology? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK009 Is a reduced-motion requirement defined for any transition or animation the design introduces? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for layout integrity at 200% browser zoom, not only at 320 px width? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is "modern and pleasant design" expressed as reviewable criteria in the requirements, rather than only interpreted in the Assumptions section? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "all four columns MUST be reachable" at 320 px quantified with a specific presentation model (vertical stacking, horizontal swipe, tabs, or accordion)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the theme control's "visible" requirement specific about its location and persistence across screens? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the accessible name of the theme control specified, so its label is not left to implementation? [Gap, Spec §FR-020, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the card ordering rule inside a column stated as a requirement, rather than only as an assumption? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Is drag-and-drop's optional status ("MAY be offered") resolved into an in-scope or out-of-scope decision that a reviewer can test? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK017 Is a visible focus indicator requirement defined, separate from the 44x44 px touch-target requirement? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK018 Do the appearance requirements and the Appearance Preference entity agree on the available values? The entity allows "follow-device" as a stored choice, but FR-018 and FR-020 describe only a light/dark switch. [Conflict, Spec §FR-018, §FR-020, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK019 Can a person who has made an explicit theme choice return to following their device preference, and is that stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the move requirements consistent with the no-scripting requirement, given that an always-visible move control must exist in both cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the scope of theme persistence consistent with board persistence, given that FR-026 covers both in one requirement while the board's per-visitor scope is still undecided? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Is SC-003's "90% of first-time users in unmoderated testing" measurable as written, given that no sample size or method is defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK023 Is SC-001's 30-second first-card target traceable to a requirement that makes it achievable, such as the add control being reachable without scrolling? [Traceability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK024 Can SC-004's "zero clipped or unreachable controls" be objectively evaluated against a defined set of screens and states? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK025 Is SC-010's perceived-readiness target tied to a defined board size and starting condition that a reviewer can reproduce? [Clarity, Spec §SC-010]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are display requirements defined for a title at the 120-character maximum on a 320 px screen (wrap, clamp, or truncate)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK027 Are display requirements defined for a note at the 2000-character maximum, including whether it is previewed, collapsed, or expandable? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK028 Are presentation requirements defined for a column holding 100+ cards, beyond the edge-case note that it "scrolls within the layout"? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for the all-columns-empty first-run state as a deliberate onboarding moment, not just four empty-state messages? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK030 Are recovery requirements defined for a person whose action fails because another tab changed the board, so they can retry without retyping? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 Is the Brazilian Portuguese interface language recorded as a requirement rather than an assumption, given that the four column labels are fixed by FR-001? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the assumed field limits (120 / 2000 characters) confirmed by the requester, since the spec flags them as defaults chosen during drafting? [Assumption, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the assumption that only deletion needs confirmation validated against the permanence of a move out of "Concluído"? [Assumption, Spec §FR-017]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK034 Is the task-versus-note entity model resolved, since the add and edit screens have two valid readings until it is? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the board's visibility scope resolved, since a shared board changes what the interface must tell a visitor about who else can see their cards? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-026]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK034 and CHK035 mirror the two open `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers tracked in `requirements.md`; they are repeated here because they block UX requirements specifically
- CHK018 is a genuine internal contradiction in the current spec, not a missing detail — resolving it changes FR-018 through FR-020
